paragraphs: Mentioned in Avot DeRabbi Natan, beginning of chapter 9; it appears that “ben Nanas” is a scribal error.[^1][^2]

notes.text: אבות דר״נ רפ״ט is read as Avot DeRabbi Natan, beginning of chapter 9, not end of chapter 89. The title abbreviation belongs to the work name, not a newly expanded title of the heading figure. No named edition is independently checked.

ונראה keeps it appears: the view that ben Nanas is a scribal error remains Hyman’s tentative textual judgment. The full patronymic stays in the heading; no deletion is made to Hebrew or translation. Abba is explicit.
